provenance: Measured via experiments.harness.evaluate_multi_seed on the CURRENT, recalibrated configs/scenarios/s3_degradation.yaml (the same config the masked-DQN/soft-reward-DQN rows in results_data.json were measured on), eval_seeds=900-907 (the same 8 eval seeds those rows use), no training (all three are non-RL baselines, agents/baselines.py). static_threshold's threshold is freshly grid-searched on this config via StaticThresholdPolicy.grid_search with a total_reward-averaged eval_fn across those same 8 eval seeds (NOT p99_latency -- the non-discriminating objective a 2026-08-19 session found and fixed; see SESSION_LOG.md), never reusing the pre-recalibration tuned value. Reproduces the 2026-08-24 Gate W3 S3 session's own grid-search scores on this identical configuration to two decimal places (0.1: -54624.69 ... 0.9: -38566.87), confirming this is a stable, deterministic measurement, not a seed artifact. Below-floor is reported the same way results_data.json reports it: floor_violations_total is the raw count (matches Table V's own column definition), below_floor_rate_mean/_std is the same quantity as a per-episode rate.
masked_dqn_and_soft_reward_for_reference: See dashboard/samples/results_data.json's s3_comparison block for the masked-DQN (total_reward_mean -10214.82025833332) and soft-reward-DQN rows this file's baselines are compared against in the paper -- not duplicated here to avoid two sources of truth for the same numbers.
